q: An RBT scored 100% on a training checklist in March. By July, performance has drifted. The likeliest explanation is:
choices: A. The original training was inadequately delivered
B. The RBT requires a different training modality
C. The written protocol itself was never effective
D. The maintenance contingencies were never arranged

q: A technician performs a skill correctly when asked but omits it during unstructured periods. Indicated:
choices: A. Task clarification specifying when it is required
B. Increasing the frequency of scheduled observation
C. A written warning documenting the omissions
D. A full behavioral skills training sequence
